widget_select_chronograph: Select a Chronograph in the widget settings.
widget_styles_later: Default widget styles will be configurable here later.
amount_of_decimals_description: Number of decimal places used for duration values in flow cards.
invalid_decimals: The amount of decimals must be between 0 and 10.
style_editor_intro: Design and save reusable widget designs and color schemes for your dashboard widgets.
style_onboarding: Copy a built-in design or color scheme to customize it.
style_transfer_invalid: This file is not a valid or supported Chronograph design or color scheme.
style_import_read_error: The selected file could not be read.
style_import_changed: The selection changed while the file was being read. Please import it again.
style_discard_switch_confirm: Discard unsaved changes to "__name__" and switch?
style_copy_size_confirm: Replace the __destination__ layout with the __source__ layout? Other size-specific settings are unchanged.
style_invalid: Every style needs a name and a valid layout and colors.
style_load_error: Saved widget styles could not be loaded because their format is not supported. They have not been changed.
style_button_text_hint: The default text is translated. Custom text is the same in every language; leave it empty to show only the icon.
style_preview_columns_hint: The preview shows three sample tiles sharing the selected design, size, state and color scheme. Their width depends on the available preview space.
style_scheme_builtin_hint: Built-in color schemes cannot be edited. Copy this scheme to customize it.
style_design_builtin_hint: Built-in designs cannot be edited. Copy this design to customize it.
style_builtin_hint: During development, edits to this default style are temporary and are not saved. They are lost when settings reload. A copy can be saved.
style_group_hint: Select the Widget bar, a row, column, or element to see its available options. Select a row, column, or element before dragging it. Drag row labels or column headers to reorder rows and columns, and drag elements into groups. Elements in a group appear together. Layouts are shared by widget types.
style_row_alignment_hint: Uses available vertical space while keeping rows in order. Minimum required height can provide extra space when other rows are hidden.
style_row_top_padding_hint: Adds space above the row's contents for this widget size.
style_row_padding_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
style_select_before_drag: Select an item before dragging it.
style_preview_builtin_hint: Local preview only: built-in edits are saved in this browser, not in the app.
style_row_span_fit_hint: When spanning visible rows, this column fits its content regardless of the width setting.
style_column_row_span_hint: Includes this row. Hidden rows collapse; other columns fit in the remaining space.
style_column_span_hint: Columns share four units, including columns spanning from earlier rows. Wider columns are reduced first when space is needed; extra columns may be merged into the last column.
style_row_column_error: This row does not have that many columns.
style_row_visibility_hint: A row is visible in the selected states.
style_row_hide_after: Hide after duration (closes the start form)
style_row_invalid: Enter a duration between 0.1 and 86400 seconds.
style_progress_hint: Settings apply to this size. The preview shows sample progress; transition markers use the preview step count (2-100), or five steps by default.
style_column_reorder_same_row: Columns can only be moved within the same row.
style_delete_scheme_confirm: Permanently delete the custom color scheme "__name__"?
style_field_rows_hint: Set the number of input rows for this size. Defaults: timer 1, transition 2. Narrow fields may truncate their contents.
style_height_size_hint: Height is configured separately for each size. Change the preview size to edit it.
style_drag_hint: Drag elements to a cell, or select an element and then its destination. Layouts are saved separately for each size and shared across widget types.
style_color_status_hint: Set default colors in the inactive state. Other states inherit them unless overridden.
roundOfDurationsFlowcards: Round of numbers from the 'Get the Duration of [x]' flowcards.
style_allow_shrink: Allow elements to shrink on narrow widgets
style_size_default: App default: __size__ px. Leave empty to use the default.
style_size_hint: Text and icon sizes use font size; buttons and fields use height; the status bar uses thickness. Enter a value from 4 to 100 px.
style_size_invalid: Enter a whole number from 4 to 100.
widget_design_unavailable: The selected widget design is no longer available.
widget_scheme_unavailable: The selected widget color scheme is no longer available.
error_not_configured: Chronograph not found in app configuration.
error_name_conflict: Chronograph name conflicts with an active instance.
multiple_invalid_settings: Some widget settings are invalid. Please check the widget settings.
